descripcion_geo: Mountain range on Israel's northern border with Syria and Lebanon, with its highest point at 2,814 m. Covered in snow much of the year.
importancia_estrategica: Northern border of the land of Israel; Its waters feed the Jordan and the lake of Galilee.

historias.descripcion: Psalm 133 describes brotherly unity as the dew of Hermon descending on Mount Zion.
The majority tradition identifies Hermon as 'the high mountain' where Jesus was transfigured before Peter, James and John.

historias.titulo: Zion and Hermon cry out for God
historias.descripcion: Psalm 42 mentions the land of Jordan and the heights of Hermon as a place of mourning and hope in God.

personajes.descripcion: According to tradition, he was transfigured in Hermon; His face shone like the sun.
Eyewitness of the Transfiguration on the high mountain; He evoked the event in his second letter.
Hermon was a place of worship to Baal; his primitive name 'Baal-Hermon' attests to this (Judg 3:3).

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Holy mountain on the northern boundary of Israel; place of worship Canaanite (Baal-Hermón) and possible scene of the Transfiguration of Jesus.

judaismo.descripcion: Hermon was 'the Sinai of the north': the place where the Canaanites gods met according to Ugaritic mythology.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Hermon was 'the Sinai of the north': the place where the Canaanites gods met according to Ugaritic mythology.

cristianismo.fuente_primaria: Nuevo Testamento / Padres de la Iglesia
cristianismo.descripcion: The Transfiguration on the high mountain reveals the divine glory of Jesus before selected witnesses.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The Transfiguration on the high mountain reveals the divine glory of Jesus before selected witnesses.

historias.descripcion: Jesus climbs the high mountain (tradition = Hermon) with Peter, James and John; he transfigures and converses with Moses and Elijah.
Peter, excited, proposes to build three stores; A cloud surrounds them and the voice of the Father speaks.

historias.titulo: The descent and the instruction of silence
historias.descripcion: Jesus orders the three not to tell the vision until he rises from the dead.

personajes.descripcion: He was transfigured on the high mountain, revealing his divine glory.
Witness of the Transfiguration; He evoked it as the foundation of his apostolic testimony.

personajes.rol: Representatives of the Law and the Prophets
personajes.descripcion: They appeared in the Transfiguration as witnesses that Jesus fulfills all the previous revelation.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Hermon as a 'sacred mountain' where the glory of God was manifested in the Transfiguration.

cristianismo.fuente_primaria: Nuevo Testamento / Padres de la Iglesia
cristianismo.descripcion: Hermon/high mountain is the Sinai of the NT: where God reveals his glorified Son, fulfilling the Law and the Prophets.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Hermon/high mountain is the Sinai of the NT: where God reveals his glorified Son, fulfilling the Law and the Prophets.
